phases.title: Unified NEXUS Local Boot Foundation: Service Manifest, Status, and Doctor
phases.summary: Introduced the service manifest plus read-only nexus:status and nexus:doctor commands.
knownLimitations: No process management in this phase.

phases.title: Unified NEXUS Local Boot Process Manager
phases.summary: Added nexus:up and nexus:down with localhost-only process management and managed PID tracking.
knownLimitations: Service health UI was deferred to P41.6.3.

phases.title: Command Center Service Health UX
phases.summary: Adds a read-only Service Health route with service cards, command guidance, doctor findings, and troubleshooting.
checksRun: cd dashboard && npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:pages
knownLimitations: UI execution of nexus:up, nexus:down, nexus:status, and nexus:doctor is not enabled yet.
check:public-safety still has known pre-existing roadmap false positives.

phases.title: NEXUS Command Palette + Simple Operator Actions
phases.summary: Planned next phase for simple operator actions after Service Health visibility is complete.
